prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new wide landscape environment concept painting for Ashveil, matching the supplied village-edge reference's hand-painted animated fantasy art, brushwork, warm ivory limestone, terracotta roofs, teal cloth, ochre earth and lush soft foliage. Reference is style/material guidance, not an edit target. Scene: Alderbank refuge on the safe bank of River Alder, opening MMORPG chapter. Environment is the subject: a modest lived-in riverside hamlet, shelter awnings with dry bedding and medical supplies, communal meal table and small refuge fire, repaired handcart and practical workshop, people quietly helping one another. Several small adult figures give scale, including one ivory-hooded traveller with teal shoulder cloth and ochre cape matching reference, not a portrait. Composition: broad readable courtyard in foreground, paths connecting cottages and riverside shelter, river and a damaged old crossing glimpsed in distance. Hopeful late-afternoon light, intimate small settlement not grand city or refugee misery spectacle. Strong clear architectural silhouettes and broad walkable space, painterly detail rather than photorealism. No text, labels, UI, watermark, combat, lava or burning landscape. Landscape 16:9.

Use case: stylized-concept. One new wide landscape environment painting for Ashveil. Supplied image is style/material reference only. Match its warm hand-painted animated fantasy, ivory limestone, ochre paths, terracotta cottages, teal accents and brushy lush foliage. Scene: the orchard and wagon road outside Alderbank in first chapter. Broad curved walkable road passes a stranded wooden supply wagon with a tilted wheel, scattered useful bundled cloth and tools, modest field fences, a little irrigation channel and a sunlit orchard with handmade beehives. Near the wagon two small adult workers and a pack goat; further away an orchard keeper tends trees. Environment-focused view from gently raised hillside, clear relationship between wagon quest area and independent farm/orchard paths, intimate and buildable zone scale with landmarks, not gigantic open world. Playful pastoral ordinary life, pale wildflowers, dappled morning sunlight, distant small refuge rooftops. Not every location about ash; no ash corruption in this scene. No oversized foreground hero. No text, labels, UI, logos, watermark, photorealism. 16:9 landscape single scene.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new 16:9 wide environment concept painting for Ashveil's first four-person dungeon, The Broken Waystation. Supplied ash-boundary image is style and material reference, not an edit target. Match painterly animated fantasy brushwork, cream limestone, ochre accents, teal/cyan magical inlays, natural foliage. Scene: a modest old riverside waystation built beneath the surviving abutment of a BROKEN river crossing. Camera looks diagonally down a broad navigable cream-stone staircase toward a grounded arched service entrance, with the river visible beyond broken bridge piers. One ruin complex, plausible small first dungeon, not a cathedral or giant city. Healthy green moss near sunlit upper stairs progressively loses colour nearer entrance; fine cyan ward channels turn violet deeper below. Ash means eerie desaturation and stillness, not fire, lava, smoke disaster or gothic spikes. Four SMALL adult adventurers on stairs for scale, one ivory hood/teal scarf/ochre cape matching reference, other three simple practical silhouettes, readable environment remains dominant. Warm sky daylight above contrasts with muted cool entrance. Service gate, drainage grilles, practical pipework, fallen bell near outer wall and a sheltered rally landing. Clear walkable width for four players, charming worn material language. No text, UI, logos, watermark, blood, photorealism.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new wide 16:9 environment concept painting for Ashveil dungeon The Broken Waystation: the failing ward engine interior. Reference image establishes hand-painted animated fantasy brushwork, cream limestone masonry, teal/cyan detailing and ochre/brass material language; style reference only, NOT a copy of exterior composition. Camera at slightly elevated player height overlooking a medium sized vaulted underground river-control chamber, modest early dungeon scale. Central squat practical stone-and-brass ward engine with luminous cyan water-current conduits disrupted by a violet surge. EXACTLY THREE obvious handwheel regulators on separate low pedestals around the engine, broad readable continuous floor and walkways connecting them, golden circular grounding inlays on floor. Shallow water channels, moss, worn steps, speaking pipes, drainage grilles and a side stair suggest once useful civic infrastructure. Four small adult adventurers stand together near entrance for scale, one ivory hood teal scarf ochre cape, others simple gear. Warm light from small high daylight shafts meets cooler cyan and violet light; retain visible cream stone and green moss, selected moss and stone beyond damaged conduit drain towards ash grey. Mysterious and inviting exploration, not horror, not black dungeon, not sci-fi reactor or lava factory. Environment dominates; no fighting or effects obscuring layout. No readable text, labels, UI, watermark or logos. Concept art, not a screenshot.
